---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new feature for Enigma
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...").

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Plugin category (if applicable)**
- [ ] Search Plugin (new data source/provider)
- [ ] Filter Plugin (cleaning/deduplicating)
- [ ] Rank Plugin (scoring/weighting)
- [ ] UI / Output Formatting
- [ ] Other

**Additional context**
Add any other context, API documentation links, or mockups about the feature request here.
